description: 1） NVIDIA Unveils Project GR00T Humanoid Robot Base Model At this year's annual GTC developer conference, NVIDIA introduced a humanoid robot project called GR00T, possibly paying tribute to Marvel's superhero Groot. NVIDIA referred to this new platform as the "Universal Humanoid Robot Base Model", providing an AI platform for emerging humanoid robot manufacturers such as 1X Technologies, Agility Robotics, Apptronik, Boston Dynamics, Figure AI, Fourier Intelligence, Sanctuary AI, Ubtech, and Xiao…
classificationReason: Primarily covers NVIDIA GR00T, a humanoid-robot foundation model, including imitation from human demonstrations, simulation hardware, and industry adoption.
qualityReason: Focused multi-item technology news roundup with substantial robotics coverage, though not a dedicated interview or deep technical analysis.
